name: Content jobs engine v2
objective: Create a source-grounded daily/weekly/content draft machine from approved Discord knowledge and real member activity, with manual approval before public posting.
implemented: Added lib/discord/content-jobs-v2.ts with an approved source registry over closed questions, helpful answers, published content queue items, and approved/published drafts.
Added strict Zod schema parsing for generated content job drafts.
Added Phase 10 quality gates for approved source IDs, source citations, source markers, concrete action, target channel, draft type, policy, content quality, and privacy guard.
Added DeepSeek-backed content job generation with source provenance, prompt version, trace metadata, quality gates, and source refs stored on discord_content_drafts.metadata.
Added generic approved-draft publishing that refuses unapproved drafts, writes published_message_id, and idempotently skips already-published drafts.
Added admin dashboard publish action and button for approved drafts in /admin/discord.

Added a live smoke script that creates an approved source, generates a resource drop through DeepSeek, approves it, publishes it to Discord, verifies duplicate publish is blocked, deletes the Discord smoke message, and cleans up database rows.
Added focused Playwright proof that an approved content job draft can be published from the admin dashboard and cleaned up.

verification.evidence: DeepSeek generated resource_drop draft b7f4badd-f6ff-452e-a9c6-afe9b9bca248 from approved queue source b0978bef-75cf-47ba-a6f8-9b90734b03ab; qualityScore 90 at generation and 100 after persisted evaluation; published Discord message 1519464724226637825; second publish skipped as already_published; message and rows cleaned up.

Initial run failed because the seeded draft title appeared in both AI approval and RAG corpus panels. Test was fixed to target the publish button test id. Rerun passed: 1 Chromium test passed, live Discord message deleted, database rows cleaned up.
Next.js production build completed. Existing non-blocking warnings remain for middleware deprecation, edge runtime static generation behavior, and academy cookie dynamic-render logs.
Fresh one-off gateway worker opened successfully.
Project sageideas-discord-worker, environment production, service sagebot-gateway.
Production gateway container is running and reconnecting. Logs repeatedly show socket open and socket closed 4000/1006, confirming Phase 14 durability hardening is still needed.

verification.command: Supabase observation query for last 24h discord_messages, gateway_events, heartbeats, and dead letters
verification.evidence: 2 real member messages captured in last 24h from JD_PGA in introductions; 102 gateway events; 0 gateway dead letters; sagebot-main heartbeat status heartbeat_ack at 2026-06-24T22:12:43.848Z with sequence 247.

what_is_real: Approved Discord sources can now become pending content drafts with source provenance.
Generated drafts use a strict JSON schema instead of free-form parsing.
Generic/thin/private/unsupported drafts are blocked before insertion as pending public drafts.
Admins can publish approved drafts from /admin/discord.
Published drafts store the Discord message ID.
Duplicate publish is idempotently blocked by the published draft state.
Live smoke and E2E both posted to Discord and deleted their test messages.
what_is_not_done: The production gateway worker is alive, but logs show recurring close code 4000 and occasional 1006 reconnects.
The system has captured real member messages, but real community knowledge volume is still low because the server is early.
The generic content jobs v2 layer exists, but cron orchestration for every job type should be hardened in Phase 14 rather than crammed into this phase.
remaining_master_plan: Phase 14 - Durable jobs/retries/dead letters and gateway close-code cleanup
Phase 20 - Final scorecard and operating rhythm
